posts.content_md:
Over the last 8 years i have been given a number of holograms from forum members. It is really fun having a dozen or so holograms from people that post here. 

This weekend Bob Hess came by to visit and droped by one of his holograms. It is a H-2 of a Koeler Faucet he made for a display. Wow!

Thank you to Bob and everyone for helping us work out these ideas on the forum. And also thank you for the holograms.
